# GitHub — GitHub for Startups

$10,000 in flexible GitHub credits applied to an Enterprise account for up to 12 months, usable across GitHub Enterprise, Copilot, Advanced Security, Actions and other metered offerings; only available through an affiliated partner.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open, but needs an accelerator, VC or partner code |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [🛠️ Developer Tools](../categories/devtools.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $10,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Credits are valid for up to 12 months from approval. Credits expire upon full consumption or at the end of the 12-month period, whichever occurs first. |
| **When it ends** | Upon credit exhaustion or program expiration, any active products will automatically transition to standard paid billing and will be charged to the payment method on file. |


### Not covered

- Enterprises with data residency
- startups that have previously received GitHub Enterprise credits through Microsoft or GitHub for Startups
- startups on a GitHub Enterprise plan within the past six months

> **Stacking:** One-time redemption; credits cannot be transferred to another account. Downgrading before credits are consumed forfeits the remainder and bars reapplication.

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

'Up to Series B or earlier' is a stage ceiling, not a dollar figure, so funding_max_usd is null. The page notes 'our previous startup offer has been discontinued and is no longer available' - that refers to a prior GitHub offer, not this one. A valid payment method is required and an authorization charge is taken; failure to have one locks the account. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
